next.reason: 1985 (1993 amendment): an unsuccessful OPEN leaves 'the physical file' unaffected, then a. sets the I-O status, then b. executes 'Any applicable USE AFTER EXCEPTION procedure'. §2023:14.9.27.4 GR25 keeps the same order: 'the file is not affected', a) the I-O status is set, d) the applicable USE procedure is executed. The new step b) applies only 'If it is enabled', and §2023:14.6.13.1.1 says 'By default, checking is not enabled for any exception condition'. The new step c) needs an exception-checking PERFORM. §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 runs the USE procedures when the statement 'was not specified within the scope of an exception-checking PERFORM statement'. A 1985 program behaves the same.
